bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Source-free deterministic reasoning over the exact predecessor reasoning STATE and frozen current authority tuple. Scope is limited to the role-local repository p→c→a CAS/checkpoint verifier. It proves equivalence of an ordered boolean guard program to the existing verifier table under explicit one-hot classification preconditions, plus duplicate-ADVANCE safety under acknowledgement ambiguity. It does not establish an external-effect primitive, external exactly-once semantics, or Phase-1 acceptance. No O/downstream/other-worker semantics, shared ledger, legacy input, protected/manual execution, hosted compute, finite quota, public research, or scheduler mutation were used.

preconditions: Exactly one of U,C,A_t,F_t is true.
Exactly one of P,S,A_o,O is true.
For nonterminal states, V is the exact frozen-lineage validity predicate over expected p,slice_id,c,a.

bounded_leaf_result.equivalence_proof: Terminal rows take precedence and reproduce table absorption independently of lineage validity or observation. For nonterminal invalid lineage, guard 3 reproduces the table's unconditional fence. For nonterminal valid lineage, one-hot state and observation classification selects exactly the corresponding U or C table cell. Therefore the ordered program and verifier table return the same action on every well-formed input.
bounded_leaf_result.guard_disjointness_proof: Guards 1 and 2 are disjoint by state one-hotness and exclude every nonterminal guard. Guard 3 requires NOT V, while guards 4-11 require V. Within guards 4-7 the U state is fixed and P,S,A_o,O are pairwise exclusive; within guards 8-11 the C state is fixed with the same pairwise-exclusive observations; U and C are mutually exclusive. Hence no two enabled guards overlap on a well-formed input, so ordering is semantically redundant after validation and only makes execution explicit.
bounded_leaf_result.coverage_proof: Every well-formed input has exactly one state. A_t and F_t are covered by guards 1-2. For U or C, either V is false and guard 3 fires, or V is true and exactly one of P,S,A_o,O is true, selecting exactly one of guards 4-11. Thus the guard set is total over the stated input domain and has no fall-through case.
bounded_leaf_result.duplicate_advance_ack_ambiguity_proof: The only mutating ADVANCE rule is guard 9, which requires V AND C AND exact observation S, meaning the repository still equals deterministic certificate c. Its target a is uniquely derived from the same frozen lineage. If CAS2 succeeds but its acknowledgement is lost, a later exact read observes A_o, so guard 10 recovers A without mutation; guard 9 is then false. If the later read still observes S, the prior CAS2 did not durably replace c and replay targets the identical a. Any concurrent successful replacement of c makes a subsequent CAS expecting c fail or changes the observation away from S. Therefore at most one successful ADVANCE can consume c for one lineage, and acknowledgement loss cannot create a second logical ADVANCE.
bounded_leaf_result.machine_checkable_core: assert onehot(U,C,A_t,F_t) and onehot(P,S,A_o,O); evaluate guards 1..11 in order; no default branch is reachable under the assertions.
bounded_leaf_result.exact_missing_capability: A concrete Chat-capable zero-Work, zero-finite-quota, zero-incremental-cost external-effect primitive whose documented/testable semantics satisfy every required G+I+V gate and can compose with repository ADVANCE without an unobservable accept-no-ack side-effect gap.
